title: Sharḥ al-Basmala

date.basis: MS Majlis 10196 copy date, asterisked by Melvin-Koushki as possibly transcription; terminus ad quem only.

addressee: Marginal dedication to Ulugh Beg (MS Majlis 10196 f. 332b); a copy sent to Qāżīzāda Rūmī (per his letter, f. 153a). Melvin-Koushki's timeline says copies went to both.
occasion: not stated beyond the sending of copies
manuscript: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 332b-51b; MS Sipahsālār 2930/20 ff. 6b-9b (845/1441).
summary: A commentary on the basmala in the lettrist manner, sent to Qāżīzāda Rūmī and carrying a marginal dedication to Ulugh Beg in the Majlis manuscript.
